column1: # tools/mutations/m1-expected.tsv (1.4 M1; docs/M7D_CONTRACT.md §6 "変異の置き場所", §3.10, §4.2): the UI mutations of the
# branch r14-duo-m1, which is never merged. A push of it runs duo.yml's duo-shots once (path 3: the iPhone Duo's outer screen
# only; build.yml ignores r14-duo*). Each mutation is one line of the app marked "MUTATION <id>" and is told by the name of
# the one DuoLayoutUITests test it fails; no two share a set, none stops the build, crashes the app or fails a step before
# the UI tests. Base: 65734cc (r14-w-d1d), whose own duo-shots must pass first (its testFingerDefaultFollowsTheHinge expects
# off on the outer screen since 1.4 D1c).
# The run expected: the build, the photo checks' self-test, the photos and "The simulators used are the table's" pass;
# "DuoLayoutUITests on the iPhone Duo" fails with 4 ran, 3 failed (U1, U2, U3 below), testOuterHeaderRows passed and
# testInnerHeaderIsOneRow skipped; "The photos and the lines (shot_checks.py)" fails with exactly 1 error, U1's
# (outer-portrait-week-first.png finger=true, expected false). Any other failure, or a test named here passing, is a finding.
# The UI gate (duo.yml:1180-1214) fails the step unless at least DUO_UI_MIN_RAN_PATH3 (duo.yml:456, "4") ran and 0 failed,
# skipped ones not counted. This run shows only the failures half: no mutation makes fewer than 4 run. The ran-count half
# was checked without CI, with the gate's Python taken from duo.yml and run on made-up logs: 3 passed and 2 skipped
# (testOuterHeaderRows too) gives "::error::3 DuoLayoutUITests ran on the iPhone Duo (skipped ones are not counted); at
# least 4 must", exit 1; this run's expected log gives "4 ran (3 failed), 1 skipped" and the error naming U1-U3's tests,
# exit 1; 4 passed and 1 skipped gives exit 0.
# One more run after a simulator failure (run_screen, duo.yml:1116-1131): the first log is kept as duo-ui-tests-first.log
# (:1123), the second takes the name duo-ui-tests.log (:1129), and the attachments come from the second xcresult (:1130,
# :1173). The mutations fail the same tests in both runs.
# This file is r14-duo-m1's. r14-q-m1 (build.yml's quick lane) has a different file at the same path; cite each as
# branch:path.
# Rows with the id "-" are not mutated on this branch (why in the row). Columns: id, the line mutated, what it does, the
# contract row it proves, the tests expected to FAIL, the nearest tests that must still PASS.

PencilPhone.usesHinge stays true, the value DuoLayoutUITests.swift:52, duo.yml's DUO_USES_HINGE and shot_checks' section 4.2 rule agree on. The app takes the path it took with usesHinge false at f9bb459 (duo.yml run 44696154794: 15 photos and 4 UI tests passed), so no crash. After the UI tests, shot_checks.py fails with exactly 1 error (outer-portrait-week-first.png finger=true, expected false; shot_checks.py:464-468; the rule check is :475-481); its section 4.2 rule check still passes, since hinge= comes from ScreenshotMeasure's own interaction (ScreenshotMode.swift:1150-1151) and --uses-hinge from duo.yml:468. Checked on that run's photos and lines: 15 photos, 1 error.

column3: A known gap: no test on path 3 proves 「外側は .large で」. With .medium on the outer screen testSheetsFitOnDuo would still pass: its event half (DuoLayoutUITests.swift:185-197) asks only that 「保存」 and 「キャンセル」, toolbar buttons at the sheet's top (EventEditorSheet.swift:224, :229), are hittable and on the window, and its purchase half (:212-220) drags up to 6 times, so the sheet still scrolls to the EULA row and the bottom 「あとで」 (worked out from the code, not run). A mutation cannot show it; a test change can (the sheet's top or height asserted). The rule that picks .large on every phone window (WindowClass.usesFormSheet false while formSheetOnWide is false, the Duo's outer portrait and landscape included) is checked by swift run KitChecks (TegakiKit/Sources/KitChecks/WindowFingerChecks.swift:106-122), not by this run.

column3: Excluded on path 3 by the lead (docs/M7D.md, D1's note B-3). §6 row U's header mutation (compactWidth's comparison back to the idiom) cannot fail a test that runs on path 3: the outer screen's portrait column is 382 pt (window 466 less the 84 pt side strip, run 44696154794), compact by width (below 600) and by idiom (.phone) alike, so its header is two rows either way and testOuterHeaderRows passes with or without the mutation. Only the inner screen (wide, idiom .phone) tells the two rules apart, in testInnerHeaderIsOneRow, which skips on path 3 (DuoLayoutUITests.swift:75-76, :277-282). It joins this branch with the inner screen (paths 1 and 2).
